title: Greek Clinical De-identification Benchmark: 500 synthetic discharge notes with arbitrated gold standard, scoring rules and system outputs
description:
First benchmark for clinical-text de-identification in Greek. 500 fully synthetic discharge notes (300 cardiac surgery, 100 cardiology, 100 nephrology) generated by a frontier LLM (Gemini 3.1 Pro, Google) under fixed hospital-layout skeletons; 7,937 must-redact identifier instances (dual full independent review, F1 = 0.998, arbitrated) and 6,747 must-survive clinical probes enabling measurement of over-redaction — a dimension existing de-identification benchmarks do not score. Includes realistic PDF renderings, the complete scoring implementation, and the evaluated system's full outputs and per-decision results for two independent runs (pipeline fingerprint 765328fbf1241ea4).

All content is synthetic; no real patient data was used at any stage.

Data are licensed CC BY 4.0; the scoring scripts in scoring/ are MIT-licensed.
